say:1:1430217401:1.text: Of course, I did! When he proposed, I actually jumped for joy!
say:1:1430217401:1.source_cn: 当然！当他向我求婚的时候，我整个人都快要跳起来！
say:1:1430217401:1.male: Of course, I did! When he proposed, I actually jumped for joy!
say:1:1430217401:1.female: Of course, I did! When he proposed, I actually jumped for joy!

say:2:1430217402:1.text: I was so stupid earlier. Struggling with this and that. But he has enough courage for both of us.
say:2:1430217402:1.source_cn: 我觉得之前的纠结好傻，他比我勇敢太多。
say:2:1430217402:1.male: I was so stupid earlier. Struggling with this and that. But he has enough courage for both of us.
say:2:1430217402:1.female: I was so stupid earlier. Struggling with this and that. But he has enough courage for both of us.
